descriptions.value: Vulnerability in the Oracle Agile PLM product of Oracle Supply Chain (component: Import).   The supported version that is affected is 9.3.6. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with logon to the infrastructure where Oracle Agile PLM executes to compromise Oracle Agile PLM.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle Agile PLM accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 6.2 (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N).
